svg.text: BUSINESS-PROCESS & PRODUCTION WORKFLOWS — INGEST · EXTRACT · VALIDATE · DELIVER · PROVE
SOURCE SYSTEMS · NONE OF THEM RELIABLE, ALL OF THEM AUTHORITATIVE
a register number is not a meaning
status code is not a contract
INGEST · AT-LEAST-ONCE, DEDUPED ON CONTENT HASH
every payload stored raw before anything reads it · SHA-256 assigned at the door
arrival time and event time are recorded separately — they are never the same thing
amber = worker in backoff, replaying a transient failure
a crashed worker loses no work — the record returns to the queue
reprocessing is safe by construction, not by convention
deterministic rules first · model only where rules cannot reach
every value keeps a pointer to the exact source span it came from
a record that fails here never reaches an output
validation runs before persistence — never after
it does not reconstruct a guess
RETRY WITH EXPONENTIAL BACKOFF — transient failure is the expected case, not the exception
low confidence, contradicted, or failing a hard gate
these are never auto-accepted — a person decides, and that decision is recorded
DELIVERY · THE AUTOMATION IS ONLY DONE WHEN THE RECEIVING SYSTEM AGREES
rejected writes come back as exceptions
every figure drills back to its source
alert on exception, silence on success
who, what, when, from which bytes
answers the question asked six months later

g.text: the other 5.8 % is routed to a person on purpose
same input, same output, six months later
no full replay to repair one record
a dropped record raises — it never just logs
